principles.reason: Readers rely on what they saw.
principles.statement: A published version MUST NOT be changed in place.
principles.title: Versions stay as published

principles.statement: An invitation MUST name the person who sent it.
principles.title: Senders are named

data.next: The principles have changes that are not published: publish them so the builders get them.
data.note: A principle is one sentence that must hold in every slice. Each slice's spec answers every active one; a principle added or changed binds slices marked ready afterwards.
